name: Approving a matched row clears the resident's balance
title: SC-07-02-02 Approving a matched row clears the resident's balance
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a statement row is matched to unit "A Blok D:14"
When the manager approves the match
Then the dues of unit "A Blok D:14" are paid
And the resident's hero balance shows 0.00
